'''N'Vadin''' was a shop located in the [[Port Shopping Arcade]] on the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]{{'s}} [[Bazaar Deck]]. It specialized in [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] formal wear, and clothing retailed between fifty to two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was staffed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Maelstrom" />
